details.description: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct is Meta's instruction-tuned, multilingual 70-billion-parameter chat model, released December 6, 2024. It is optimized for multilingual dialogue, coding assistance, mathematical reasoning, and tool use, and officially supports eight languages. Meta positions it for commercial and research use as an assistant-like chatbot and for synthetic data generation or model distillation.
advantages: Meta reports 86.0% on MMLU (CoT) and 92.1% on IFEval (instruction following) for the instruction-tuned model.
Meta reports 88.4% pass@1 on HumanEval for coding and 77.0 on MATH (CoT).
Meta reports 91.1% on MGSM, a multilingual math benchmark, for the instruction-tuned model.
Supports a 128k-token context window per Meta's model card.
disadvantages: Meta states performance degrades outside the eight officially supported languages and recommends system-level safeguards for agentic deployments.
Meta reports a lower GPQA Diamond score of 50.5%, well below its MMLU and coding results.
use_cases: Synthetic data generation and model distillation

notes: Catalog's 131072 max input/output tokens matches Meta's stated 128k context window for this model; no conflict.
